title: refactor(objectql): one shared host per facet in the engine.ts codemod stubs (body-identical; engine.ts 14,140 -> 13,548)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQdjPLZDve4g9Vssqoo6oK8)_

Fixes #30051

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 改为每个 facet 只建一个共享 host（每个引擎实例一份，首次调用时由类的 static 块安装的工厂建成，存在新模块 `engine-facet-hosts.ts`），类上的 stub 从「每次调用现建一个 host 字面量」变成一行 `Facet.x.call(xHost.of(this), …)`。从 base 重新生成，生成物未手改。`engine.ts` 14,140 → 13,548 行（−592）。`protocol.ts` 不动：它的 codemod 存根本来就走共享的 `protocolHost(this)`，没有可压缩的。
- 为什么改：维护者在 #30012 上要求进一步压缩 `engine.ts`（「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」），本卡是其中的 stub 压缩一项。
- 风险与回滚：只改 stub 和新增 host 模块，161/161 方法体、146/146 顶层声明逐字节不变，撤销拆分逐字节还原 base `engine.ts`；打包后 6 个 `.d.ts` 与 main 逐字节相同；objectql 测试 base 547 文件/10,833 = head；回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：① `packages/objectql/src/engine-facet-hosts.ts`（`FacetHost` 缓存，78 行）；② `engine.ts` 类末尾第二个 static 块（16 个 host 工厂）；③ codemod 里的 `hostsTexts` / `stubBody` 和 `verify` 新增的 stub 与 host 校验。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 后运行 `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --verify --base c2d353d2`，应看到 `161/161 moved bodies identical`、`23245 -> 13548 lines`，退出码 0；`--self-test` 应通过 68 例。
- 需要你做的：改动共 1,996 行（未超过 3,000 行线），但按席位裁决本 PR 保持草稿，在您定的窗口里落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`.** Each facet's host is now built ONCE per engine instead of once per call.
  - `hostsTexts` writes a new module, `engine-facet-hosts.ts`. It holds `FacetHost`, a `WeakMap` cache keyed by engine with a factory slot, and one exported instance per facet module (`actionsHost`, `cascadePlanningHost`, …, 16 in all). The module imports types only, so it forms no evaluation cycle and is evaluated before the class whichever module loads first. This matters because 4 facet modules import `ObjectQLStatics` from `engine.ts` by value, so a cache inside a facet module could be in its temporal dead zone when the class's static block runs.
  - A second static block at the end of `ObjectQL` installs each facet's factory: `xHost.install((engine) => ({ … }))`. The factory forwards each member as the per-call literal did. A method is a closure called on the engine at call time (`m: (...a) => engine.m(...a)`), so a spy or subclass override installed later is still reached. A field or accessor is a getter, and a field a body assigns also gets a setter. The host is the facet's whole host interface (`ActionsHost` and so on), which satisfies every body's `Pick`. A static block adds no class member, so the `.d.ts` does not move.
  - `stubBody` writes `return Facet.x.call(xHost.of(this), …args);` (a generic method still calls its body instantiated with its own type parameters). A stub whose body reads no member is unchanged.
  - A facet host can be told apart from a per-call literal only by identity across calls. No moved body can observe that: a body that reads `this` bare already stays on the class (`bare-this`).
  - `verify` now also checks that (1) every stub equals the generated one-call stub for its method, facet and host, (2) `engine-facet-hosts.ts` equals the generated text for the host interfaces on disk, and (3) the install block equals the generated block. Each member is forwarded by its BASE class kind: a method as a closure, anything else as a getter, plus a setter when the interface does not mark it `readonly`. The undo drops the block and the import.
  - Generation refuses when `engine.ts` already binds a host name, or when a moving method has a parameter named after its facet's host.
  - `--self-test`: 68 cases in 6 batteries. "facets, statics and docblocks" goes from 11 to 17 cases, and its floor is raised to 17. The new refusals: a stub handing another facet's host, an edited host module, and a written field's setter left out.
- **The regenerated split.** `--write` on `engine.ts` at `c2d353d2` (main's last unsplit `engine.ts`; nothing has touched `engine*.ts` since #30012 merged as `237f5137`), unedited. The diff: `engine.ts` (145 stubs lose their literal, plus the install block and one import), the new `engine-facet-hosts.ts`, and the header prose of the 16 facet modules (the host paragraph). No body moved.
- **`protocol.ts` / `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs`: no change.** The card's premise does not hold for this file. Its 85 codemod stubs already reach their bodies through one shared host per instance, `ProtocolClassHeadFacet.x(protocolHost(this), …)` (`protocol-host.ts`, a `WeakMap` cache installed by the class's static block). That is the shape this PR gives `engine.ts`. `grep -c 'const host: ThisParameterType' scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` reads 0. The per-call literals left in `protocol.ts` (164 stubs, 774 lines) are all hand-series stubs that the codemod did not write (see Acceptance notes).

### Line counts

| File | Before (main `c23501b2`) | After | Δ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` | 14,140 | 13,548 | −592 |
| `packages/objectql/src/engine-facet-hosts.ts` | — | 78 | +78 |
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` | 13,647 | 13,647 | 0 |

The card estimated about 1,000 lines off `engine.ts`. The measured figure is 592. The 145 per-call literals were 869 lines, and the install block adds back one line per host member (207 across 16 facets, plus 31 setters and 2 lines per facet). PR size: 847 additions + 1,149 deletions = 1,996 changed lines.

## Tests

<details><summary>Proofs (all at head 73a7605b unless stated)</summary>

- `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --verify --base c2d353d2`: exit 0. 161/161 moved bodies identical (body, parameters, return type, async), 146/146 top-level declarations identical, every stub equals the generated one, the host module and install block are the generated ones, and the undo rebuilds base `engine.ts` byte for byte once 107 import bindings are pruned. `engine.ts 23245 -> 13548 lines`.
- Determinism: two `--write` runs from base `engine.ts` (sha256 `dc5677f3…`), one in a separate worktree, print the same output tree sha256 `09c80319211a965b89820ab7bb650d74cf6aaaec0afc0afb9cd75f2b867e3554`. The second worktree's regenerated tree equals the committed head (`git status` empty).
- `.d.ts`: `packages/objectql/dist` built at main (`c23501b2`) ×2 and at head ×2. All 6 declaration files (`index`, `core`, `util-BWl1U61F`, each `.d.ts` + `.d.mts`) are **byte-identical** base vs head. The public-surface reading (`pubsurface.mjs` from #29986) passes base1=base2, head1=head2, base1=head1 and base2=head2, and its controls behave (a private member made public is caught, a public type change is caught, a private docblock edit is not).
- objectql `test`: base (main `c23501b2`) 547 files / 10,833 passed = head 547 / 10,833. `test:repo`: 1 file / 5 = 5.
- objectql `typecheck` (tsc + check:test-typecheck): exit 0.
- Built-dist smoke (ESM `index.mjs` and CJS `index.js`): two engines keep separate hosts (`residualOwnerSource` set on one reads `undefined` on the other), a host setter writes through (`setDefaultBodyRunner` first-wins `true`, then `false`).
- Facade gate `node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs`: exit 0, registry unchanged (2 facades, 60 exceptions). The `engine.ts` delegation kinds move from 217 host-literal stubs to 144 host delegations plus 73 host-literal stubs (the hand series). The new install block reads as a second `static host factory`.
- Durability census `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`: base (main) and head output byte-identical (51 seams, 9 propagating; 101 read seams, 13 discriminated). `--self-test` exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored; file hash back to its HEAD blob)</summary>

Done through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`.

1. verify's stub check turned off: the self-test case "a stub handing another facet's host fails" goes red.
2. verify's host-module comparison turned off: "an edited host module fails" goes red.
3. verify's install-block comparison turned off: "a written field's setter left out of the host fails" goes red.
4. On the real tree, one `engine.ts` stub pointed at another facet's host: `--verify --base c2d353d2` exits 1 with `recordResidualOwner: its stub is not the generated one-call stub`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The hand-series stubs keep their per-call literals.** In `engine.ts` that is 73 stubs (454 lines; the #25522 hand modules). In `protocol.ts` it is 164 stubs (774 lines; the #25467 hand modules). The codemods do not write those stubs, and this card's ruling is codemod-only. The same mechanism would apply (route them through the facet hosts or `protocolHost`, after widening `ProtocolHost`). By arithmetic, not a generated run, that is about −400 lines in `engine.ts` and about −700 in `protocol.ts`. Carrier: the seat, if it wants a card.
- No changeset, following #30012 and pilot #29598 (`skip-changeset`): the behaviour and the published declaration files do not change.

## Verification

Local, at head `73a7605b`:

- `npx turbo run build --concurrency=2`: 120/120 tasks, exit 0. `pnpm lint`: exit 0. objectql `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 64 families derived, each run, all exit 0. Three exited 3 on the first sweep because a prerequisite was missing (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs the pinned fixture commit fetched; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` need the full build). Each passed when rerun after its prerequisite was in place. `--ran`: 64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Run by hand, outside the derivation: `check-facade-delegation-only.mjs` (exit 0, registry unchanged), `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` (base = head output), `codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test` (68 cases).
- Declared to CI: the full lint workflow battery, core `test:repo`, and dogfood (the title has no `!` and there is no narrowing arm).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`skip-changeset`, see above)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
